# Generic base name|pool. Actors with this exact in-game name get a name from Names/<pool>/.
# Names are case-sensitive and must match the game text. Lines starting with # are comments.
# Do not leave empty lines: the first empty line ends the list.
# Pools shipped with this mod start with NOTM_. Give pools you add your own prefix.
# Every .txt file in this folder is loaded, in name order. Add-ons: ship your own file (e.g. 50_MyMod.txt), do not edit this one.
# Rule forms: Name|pool sets or replaces a rule from an earlier file. Name|- removes it.
